description: A React component rendering an execution timeline with status and timestamps, used within a web application to display workflow execution details.

methods.name: formatRelativeTime
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into a relative time string (e.g., '5m ago', 'in the future').

methods.name: normalizeStatus
methods.description: Normalizes various execution status strings into categories like 'completed', 'failed', 'running', etc.
